description: Choose this for a passive website release-security review of headers, cookie flags, mixed content, cross-origin script integrity, and server disclosure. It does not run browser QA, probe the site, execute code, or replace a security audit. Costs $0.05 USDC via x402. Successful paid calls settle the authorized USDC payment and create a stored report; settlement reduces the payer's balance and cannot be undone by this tool. The target website is not modified. Requires an x402-aware client to authorize payment.

url.description: Public HTTPS page URL. Private, loopback, credentialed, and non-HTTPS URLs are rejected.

name: web_release_gate
